snippet.title: Backrooms Lost Runners | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Backrooms: Lost Runners — a cooperative horror game where you and your friends must survive in the endless maze of the Backrooms.
Explore terrifying levels, avoid deadly entities, and find the exit before the darkness consumes you.

👥 Online Co-op
🎮 Immersive horror atmosphere
🔦 Exploration & survival

Add the game to your Steam wishlist and get ready for the challenge:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072120/Backrooms_Lost_Runners/
